calls.prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Make this exact flat shape into one Ming northern Chinese inn property in realistic ancient Chinese hand-painted map art. Preserve shape's outer perimeter and keep its corners EXACTLY where they are, especially front point(800,900) and right point(1250,675). DO NOT enlarge or shift footprint. It is a12by9m rectangle in true2:1orthographic dimetric perspective. Front edge runs600right300down; right edge runs450right225up, slopes exactly plus/minus0.5. Set a believable two-storey grey-brick hard-gable grey-tile guest house with plain wood lattices and balcony within this polygon, a short attached wing and tiny rear courtyard. Build vertically upward; all architecture axes parallel to template edges. Thin stone apron following the template exactly, sharply visible left/front/right corners. Moderately weathered grey brick, subdued grey roof, brown wood, fine subtle texture, no stylized cartoon. Opaque architecture and paving on genuinely transparent alpha0 exterior. No background tint, glow or atmosphere. Upper-left natural light with minimal lower-right contact shadow confined to floor shape. No signs, people, text, modern objects, thick plinth, steps outside footprint or cut edges. Canvas1536x1024; left(200,600), front(800,900), right(1250,675), back(650,375). Highest priority EXACT polygon silhouette; buildings must conform to it.

Replace this exact low rectangular block with a Ming northern Chinese inn, a two-storey grey brick guest house with grey tiled hard-gable roofs, dark wood balcony rails and lattice windows, a short attached wing and a tiny rear yard. Realistic muted detailed painted Chinese historical RPG architecture sprite. PRESERVE THE BLOCK GROUND OUTLINE EXACTLY. Keep front base corner(798,904), left(150,580), right(1284,661), on1536x1024canvas. Entire12by9m property fits this footprint. The ground front-left edge648right324down, front-right486right243up; both exactly26.565degrees to horizontal. True2:1dimetric orthographic, not 30degree isometric, no perspective. All walls, roof ridges, stone courses aligned to these exact axes. Thin flush flagstone apron only, visible whole base with crisp corners. Hollow the upper block into a functional inn and remove thick plinth, do not scale or change any base edge. Small reserved doorway, no signboard or lettering. Upper-left daylight, only local lower-right contact shadow, real transparent RGBA exterior alpha0, opaque architecture. No halo, no scenery, no text, no people, no modern objects, no steps outside footprint. Full roofs and ground within margins. Exact geometry is priority.

trim.method: alpha-only removal of excess thin paving edge, no body transform
